about.bio1: I am a lover of technology and programming, with a strong focus on web development. I enjoy building interactive and user-friendly applications that solve real-world problems. My journey in tech has been driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and a desire to make a positive impact through code.
about.bio2: I knew about programming when I was 11 years old, after that, I started learning programming and web development. I have been working on different projects, from small personal projects to larger applications. I am always looking for new challenges and opportunities to grow as a developer.
